key_insight: ClinVerse moves medical AI training and evaluation beyond static questions into interactive diagnostic encounters with six specialized clinical roles.
clinical_relevance: The environment tests how agents gather patient information, request examinations, and reach diagnoses rather than assessing answer accuracy alone.
method: Ground simulated encounters in ClinPatient, a dataset of 150,000 diagnostic cases derived from real-world electronic health records.
Let a doctor agent interview patients and request examinations before producing a diagnosis.
Score information acquisition, examination ordering, and diagnostic accuracy to support training and evaluation.
evidence_signal: Across general-purpose and medical-domain models, the abstract reports that nine self-evolution methods in three categories consistently improved diagnostic capabilities within ClinVerse.
watch_item: Improvements within this simulated environment do not establish safety or effectiveness in real clinical practice.
paper_title: ClinVerse: A Realistic Multi-Agent Diagnostic Environment for Training and Evaluating Medical Agents
